title: Wobbling craft may have gone into autopilot

tellings.quote: So there is a theory that since the craft was wobbling as it headed this direction and before it hit the arch lea ranch and after that that the vehicle might have gone into an autopilot.

plain: In 1948, near Aztec, New Mexico, a craft is said to have crashed with alien bodies inside. Scott Ramsay, a researcher who has spent years on the case, told podcast host Jesse Michels of a theory that because the craft was wobbling as it flew past the Archuleta Ranch, it may have switched into some kind of autopilot. That would explain how it came down where it did.
